name: Medlovice (Uherské Hradiště District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part bearing a yellow fleur-de-lis and a lower fly part of horizontal stripes of yellow, red, yellow and green.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 May 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
